description: This file defines the CustomFieldDao class, responsible for managing custom field entities within the OrangeHRM application. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching custom fields, as well as managing their associations with display fields and employee data.

classes.name: CustomFieldDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for managing CustomField entities, including CRUD operations, search, and auxiliary functions related to custom fields in the HRM system.

methods.name: saveCustomField
methods.description: Saves a CustomField entity, assigning a field number if necessary, and persists it within a transaction.

methods.name: getCustomFieldById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomField entity by its ID if it exists.

methods.name: getExistingCustomFieldIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing custom field numbers from a provided list.

methods.name: deleteCustomFields
methods.description: Deletes multiple custom fields and their associated display fields within a transaction.

methods.name: searchCustomField
methods.description: Performs a search for custom fields based on filter parameters, returning matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of custom fields matching the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: isCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Checks whether a specific custom field ID is currently in use by any employee.

methods.name: updateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Sets employee custom field values to null where they match a specific dropdown value for a given field ID.
